text: This solution, Pacific Catastrophe Risk Assessment and Financing Initiative (PCRAFI) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Papua New Guinea between World Bank, Asian Development Bank (ADB), Secretariat of the Pacific Community (SPC) via SOPAC, Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR), ACP–EU Natural Disaster Risk Reduction Programme, Global Affairs Canada, AIR Worldwide, GNS Science, Geoscience Australia, Pacific Disaster Center (PDC), and OpenGeo. The program was implemented in 2006 and focuses on collaboration and leveraging tech.
